title: Harden AOS Buffer service keys
body: Patch tools/aos/aos-buffer so operator service keys are first-class, scoped repo keys block env fallback, enc:v1 repo keys decrypt/fallback like core, manifest separates required auth from optional scope keys, and readiness remains truthfully read-only.

notes.note: Started branch codex/aos-buffer-service-keys-loop from origin/dev 51d981a5. Scope: tools/aos/aos-buffer/** plus ops/THREADMASTER_COORDINATION.md only; no Workflows/AppForge/OpenClaw/dashboard/gateway runtime touch.

Completed Buffer service-key hardening in pushed branch codex/aos-buffer-service-keys-loop at 406c2d54. Buffer remains truthful live read-only; BUFFER_API_KEY or BUFFER_ACCESS_TOKEN is required; BUFFER_BASE_URL, BUFFER_ORGANIZATION_ID, BUFFER_CHANNEL_ID, BUFFER_PROFILE_ID, BUFFER_POST_ID are optional operator defaults. Scoped repo keys block env fallback for the same variable; valid enc:v1 repo keys decrypt; unreadable encrypted keys fall back like core resolver; live_write_smoke_tested=false and write_bridge_available=false. Verification: json.tool manifest+permissions, compileall, Buffer pytest 17 passed, git diff --check HEAD~1 HEAD, pnpm check:repo-lane, architect approved. Known gaps: no real operator Buffer tenant read smoke; no write bridge/smoke; oxfmt missing in clean worktree hook but explicit checks passed.
